arStrings.szText: {icon:bullet,1.2} Entering {c_important}{u}Stealth{/u}{/c} reduces any of your {c_important}Ultimate{/c} Skills' active Cooldowns by {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"]{/c} seconds and breaking {c_important}{u}Stealth{/u}{/c} grants {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 1"|%x|]{/c} increased damage for {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 2"]{/c} seconds.
